name: go-ansible-explainable-execution-plans
instr:
go-ansible cannot expose a complete, immutable execution plan before commands start or output is consumed. Add deterministic plans for commands, nesting, configuration, output, measurement, tracing, workflow policy, and execution semantics.

Every `Planner` in `github.com/apenella/go-ansible/v2/pkg/execute` must implement `Plan(ctx context.Context) (*plan.Plan, error)` without process interaction or mutation, returning a cancelled context error first. In `github.com/apenella/go-ansible/v2/pkg/execute/plan`, `Plan`, `Step`, `Argument`, `EnvironmentChange`, `Sensitivity`, `OutputMode`, and `PlanError` must preserve order and wrapper boundaries in independent copies. `(*Plan).Validate() error` and `(*Plan).Render() (string, error)` must reject malformed values, path-qualified contradictions, and cycles, identify the offending plan path, render equivalent values identically, and redact secrets while retaining option identities and environment keys. `ErrPlanCycle` means exactly "execution plan contains a cycle". `ErrPlanUnsupported` means exactly "executor does not support planning" and retains its nested location.

In `pkg/execute`, `(*DefaultExecute).Plan(ctx context.Context) (*plan.Plan, error)` must mirror `NewDefaultExecute(options ...ExecuteOptions) *DefaultExecute`, including quiet filtering, directory, environment, output, and error enrichment. In `pkg/inventory`, `(*AnsibleInventoryExecute).Plan(ctx context.Context) (*plan.Plan, error)` must match `NewAnsibleInventoryExec
